quote_zh: In diesem Anhang sind die Mitglieder der Patentfamilien der im obengenannten europäischen Recherchenbericht angeführten Patentdokumente angegeben. ... Diese Angaben dienen nur zur Unterrichtung und erfolgen ohne Gewähr.
section_label: Annex to the European Search Report
notes: Section-level provenance for an empty extraction, not a compound record. Lines 952 to 1054 of the rebuilt document were read in full, both the German table and its EN repetition, and the section genuinely names no chemical substance. It is EPO apparatus rather than applicant disclosure: the patent family annex, giving for each of the four documents cited in the search report the family members and their publication dates, as held in the EPO file on 06-02-2008. Every cell of the table is a country code plus a publication number plus a kind code (AT 284865 T, AU 759279 B2, JP 2002527418 T and so on) with a date, that is a document identifier, not a compound. The applicant column carries company names such as BAYER CROPSCIENCE, which are not compounds either. Nothing in the section names a substance, a solvent or a crystal form. Line numbers were remapped from the pre-rebuild document via /tmp/ep2045/linemap.json; no record content changed.
